summary: A 2018 update on American conspiracy broadcaster Alex Jones after his deplatforming: his move to selling overpriced anti-aging supplements through an MLM, his drift into Trump propaganda, and his long record of bigotry and pro-Russia talking points.

evidence.note: picks up after the August 2018 bans from Twitter, Facebook and YouTube

hosts argue white identity is the constant in his politics

notes: Bonus update after the three-part Alex Jones deep-dive. The MLM is spelled phonetically in the transcript; identified as Jeunesse Global from the founders and InfoWars Yes branding. Guest surnames come from general knowledge of Knowledge Fight; the packet gives first names only. RU is a single segment of roughly five minutes.
